xmldoc.short_description: Point at a given spherical range and azimuth.

param_input_item.param_description: latitude of the start point, in degrees.
longitude of the start point, in degrees.
spherical distance to travel, in degrees of arc.
azimuth of the direction of travel, in degrees clockwise from north.

param_output_item.param_description: latitude of the destination point, in degrees.
longitude of the destination point, in degrees.

description.p: reckon computes the latitude and longitude reached by starting at the point (lat1, lon1) and travelling the great-circle distance arclen along the initial azimuth az on a sphere. All angles are expressed in degrees. The inputs are broadcast together, so a scalar start point can be combined with vectors of ranges and azimuths.
